draft.title: Rainfall variability in Australia
card: Australia is the driest inhabited continent. Much of the land, especially the inland, gets little rain.
Rainfall variability means how much rainfall changes from year to year. In Australia it changes a lot.
A run of years with much less rain than usual can bring drought. A year with heavy rain can bring floods.
So the same place can have a drought in one period and floods in another. Both are part of life in Australia.
draft.remember: Australia is dry, and its rainfall swings from year to year, so droughts and floods both happen.

opts: How much rainfall changes from year to year
How much rain falls in one wet season
How far rain travels across a continent
How rainfall is stored in dams and tanks
a.why: Variability is about change over time. A place with high variability can have a very wet year and a very dry year. Describing one season only tells you the amount of rain, not how much it changes.
a.clue: Think of the words vary and change.

b.q: A farm near Walgett has several dry years that cause drought. Then one year of heavy rain floods the paddocks. What does this show about Australia?
opts: Its rainfall changes a lot, so droughts and floods happen
Its rainfall is steady, so droughts and floods never happen
Its rainfall is high, so droughts are very rare
Its rainfall falls only in summer, so floods are usual
b.why: The farm had too little rain, then too much. That is a big change from year to year, which is high rainfall variability. Droughts and floods are both possible in the same place, so a steady or high rainfall does not fit.
b.clue: The same farm had both dry years and a flood.

a.best: How much rainfall changes from year to year

b.best: Its rainfall changes a lot, so droughts and floods happen

a.q: Which rainfall record shows high rainfall variability?
opts: 200 mm in one year, then 900 mm the next year
Close to 500 mm of rain falls in every year
Most rain falls in the same three months each year
About 1500 mm of rain falls in an average year
a.why: Rainfall variability is how much rainfall changes from year to year, and a jump from 200 mm to 900 mm is a big change. Rain that falls in the same months each year is a pattern that repeats, so it does not show big swings between years.
a.clue: Compare one year's total with the next year's.
